premises.text: Packing and shipping cost is a hidden, hard-to-determine problem for online retailers and SMB shippers
premises.evidence_span: This problem is the cost of packing and shipping. Now, why is this such a problem? It's a problem because it's so hard to determine what it costs to pack and ship something

premises.text: Customers ship diverse real items, not standard boxes that conventional carrier tools price
premises.evidence_span: Our customers don't want to know what it costs to ship a box. Our customers are retail shippers

premises.text: Without a boxed, crated, or palletized item, carriers refuse quotes and shippers spend hours or days with no comparisons
premises.evidence_span: None of these guys will give you quotes unless your item is in a box, in a crate, or on a pallet

premises.text: One website aggregates markets, converts items to packed dimensions, and returns instant multi-carrier packing and shipping quotes
premises.evidence_span: we have aggregated all of these different markets into one website

premises.text: Fulfillment includes home or office pickup, network drop-off, and same-agent local delivery
premises.evidence_span: The system facilitates not only these national jobs, but also local delivery

premises.text: Revenue is a commission on shipping, packing, insurance, and related providers
premises.evidence_span: ShipHawk makes money by collecting a commission from all the service providers that we send business to, shipping companies, packing companies, insurance companies, et cetera

domains.name: Opaque packing cost for diverse goods

value.text: Make packing and shipping easy with instant quotes and options for almost any item

secondary_value.text: Reduce real money and time shippers spend getting quotes
secondary_value.evidence_span: It costs people real money and real time

causal_links.evidence_span: This allows us to provide customers with instant data, instant packing quotes, instant shipping quotes
so hard to determine what it costs to pack and ship something
ship almost any item of almost any size or weight to almost any destination from one website
collecting a commission from all the service providers
